headline: High: Cline can write shared workspace files while Notion AI reads workspace content and sends it to vendor backends, creating default-path leakage and cascading trust risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Cline can write workspace files and use MCP, while Notion AI reads workspace pages and databases in the shared workspace. That creates a plausible prompt-injection bridge if Cline writes attacker-controlled text that Notion later summarizes or answers from. The path is not proven by docs alone, so medium is the higher safe choice.
conditions: IF Cline writes untrusted instructions into a page or file that Notion AI ingests
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize or answer from that shared content without provenance filtering
mitigations: Keep Cline and Notion AI on separate workspaces
Mark Cline-generated files as non-authoritative in page titles
Require manual review before Notion AI summarizes Cline output
Disable MCP sources that can write into Notion-consumed folders
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to shared content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Cline touches source code and browser screenshots in a workspace with filesystem sharing, and Notion AI reads workspace pages while sending content to vendor backends. If sensitive code or screenshots are copied into shared pages, Notion can transmit them off-host by default. The shared-workspace plus vendor-hosted backend combination makes medium appropriate.
conditions: IF source code or browser screenshots are placed into Notion workspace pages
IF Notion AI processes those pages while vendor backends are enabled
mitigations: Do not paste secrets or screenshots into shared Notion pages
Use a separate workspace for Cline artifacts
Restrict Notion AI access to non-sensitive pages
Redact code snippets before sending them to Notion AI
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on workspace content

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Cline has broad filesystem write and git modification, while Notion AI has no host execution, no filesystem write, and no git capability. Their write surfaces do not overlap directly, so conflict is limited to shared workspace content rather than concurrent destructive writes. That keeps the blast radius small and the severity low.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same human-managed workspace files
IF Cline modifies files that Notion AI also references
mitigations: Avoid concurrent edits to the same files
Use branch-based workflows for Cline
Keep Notion AI in read-only review mode for code artifacts
Pause one agent while the other is writing
requires-engineering: add locking around shared files

D_cascading_error.rationale: Cline can generate code and browser-derived content, and Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content. If Notion treats Cline output as authoritative, errors can cascade into summaries, decisions, or downstream actions based on unverified facts. The interaction exists in default workflows, but no direct action-taking authority is shown, so medium fits.
conditions: IF Cline writes incorrect code notes or browser findings into shared workspace content
IF Notion AI answers from that content without independent verification
mitigations: Require citations in Notion responses
Cross-check Cline outputs against source files
Use a human review step before acting on Notion summaries
Separate draft and approved pages
requires-engineering: add verification gates before downstream actions

E_compliance.rationale: Cline handles source code and browser screenshots locally, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to downstream model providers. If regulated or sensitive material is stored in the workspace, the residency and retention posture can differ across the pair. The profiles do not prove a specific legal breach, so medium is the cautious choice.
conditions: IF regulated data is stored in Notion workspace pages
IF that data is processed by Notion AI or downstream model providers
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI-enabled pages
Use a separate compliant workspace
Review vendor retention settings before use
Limit Notion AI to non-sensitive summaries
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA and residency review
